description: REGRESSION FIXTURE FOR A KNOWN BUG, NOT YET FIXED (see QA notes / bug tracker): Intro -> sign-in (last player) -> map (Near East) -> level: dismiss tutorials, walk right and jump twice across the first chamber. Around cursor (232,112) the game silently blocks on an undocumented keypress and shows a garbled/static HUD prompt box instead of readable text -- consistent with portable/game/puzzle.c's f9402() dereferencing g0dc8, a global left null-initialized in portable/generated/game_data.c (`dos_uint *g0dc8 = 0;`) and never assigned by any resource-load call. Pin the expected hashes only once this is fixed; until then this manifest documents the last-known-bad frames so a fix is easy to confirm.
